nodes.label: Desktop Build GitHub Actions Workflow
nodes.rationale: Manual runs produce downloadable artifacts; pushing a v* tag also attaches installers to a GitHub Release. Each runner builds its OWN platform natively and jlinks its OWN bundled JRE into resources/jre (gitignored), so the existing extraResources mapping (resources/jre -> jre) needs no change.

nodes.label: Cross-platform Build Matrix (mac/win/linux)
nodes.rationale: macos-14 builds --mac --arm64, windows-latest builds --win (NSIS), ubuntu-latest builds --linux (AppImage); fail-fast disabled so one platform failing does not kill the others.

nodes.label: Bundled JRE via jlink
nodes.rationale: minima.jar is Java 8 bytecode, so any modern JRE runs it. Temurin 21 LTS is available on all three runners; a minimal JRE is jlinked from it (java.se + jdk.unsupported, stripped/compressed) into resources/jre so end users need no system Java.

nodes.label: minimaCore Desktop App
nodes.rationale: A native desktop app that runs the minimaCore node locally and wears the same UI as the Minima native Android apps, starting with a self-custody wallet. Development software, not affiliated with Minima Global.

nodes.label: Thin Wrapper Around minima.jar
nodes.rationale: Design intent: rather than reimplementing a node, the app is a thin wrapper around an ever-updating minima.jar — it bundles a known-good jar + a JRE, launches the node headless with RPC, and can pull newer jars from GitHub releases as the upstream project develops.

nodes.label: Bundled JRE (no system Java needed)
nodes.rationale: The app ships a jlink-minimized JRE (java.se + jdk.unsupported) at resources/jre so no system Java is required to run the node.

nodes.label: First-run Node Wizard
nodes.rationale: First run lets the user pick network (Mainnet / Solo-test / Custom peer) plus advanced options (data folder, port, full-history).

nodes.label: Wallet Seed Onboarding (megammrsync restore + key-uses attestation)
nodes.rationale: New (fresh seed, backed up) or Restore from seed — restore fast-syncs via megammrsync in seconds. The WOTS key-uses attestation (0 for new, prior count for a restore) exists because WOTS one-time signatures are unsafe if a key-use counter is understated.
nodes.norm_label: wallet seed onboarding (megammrsync restore + key-uses attestation)

nodes.label: Node Updater (sha256-verified jar swap)
nodes.rationale: Checks a GitHub releases feed for a newer minima.jar, verifies sha256 before swapping, then restarts the node. TODO notes the updater repo still needs pinning.

nodes.label: Localhost-only RPC with Keychain-held Password
nodes.rationale: The node is launched with -rpcenable true -rpcpassword <secret> -daemon; RPC is localhost-only and the password is kept in the macOS Keychain to keep the local node off the network attack surface.

nodes.label: Design.java CSS Port (native look)
nodes.rationale: Reuses the native Design.java look via renderer/style.css — a 1:1 CSS port shared with the PandaPools MiniDapp (dark #0A0A0F, Minima-orange #F7931A, light/dark/original themes) — so the desktop matches the native Android apps instead of inventing a new design.

nodes.label: ETH Wallet Tab
nodes.rationale: Standalone ETH Wallet tab on the same seed-derived address AtomiX uses — ERC20 add-by-contract, Low/Med/High fee tiers, receive/QR, export key, Etherscan links, custom RPC. Deliberately reuses AtomiX's ETH engine so no new crypto code is introduced.

nodes.label: ETH Wallet Fund-Safety Review Fixes (0.16.1)
nodes.rationale: A deep fund-safety review found and fixed: the fee-tier selector (engine floor was masking the tiers), a hostile-RPC gas-drain path (gas + base fee both clamped), a duplicate-send lock, broadcast-ambiguity handling, EIP-55 checksum, and a token-file DoS. An executable test harness was added.

nodes.label: Web Wallet (MegaMMR-gated wallet-from-seed)
nodes.rationale: A local wallet-from-seed where keys stay on-device, gated on MegaMMR. Balance display was fixed to show confirmed (not sendable) so a funded foreign seed no longer reads zero (0.15.4-0.15.7).

nodes.label: Clipboard-via-Main-Process Fix (0.15.8)
nodes.rationale: Clipboard copy now routes through the Electron main process because the renderer's navigator.clipboard was silently failing when the window was unfocused, so the 'Copied' confirmation lied to the user.

nodes.label: Cross-platform Builds (0.13.0)
nodes.rationale: Windows (NSIS .exe) and Linux (.AppImage) builds added via the GitHub Actions matrix alongside the macOS .dmg; since 0.13.0 installers are attached to the matching GitHub Release.

nodes.label: Vestr Token-Vesting Module
nodes.rationale: Token-vesting tab with a shared covenant and 3-way interop with the native apps (0.11.0).

nodes.label: AtomiX Atomic-Swap Module
nodes.rationale: The AtomiX atomic-swap tab is the 3rd interoperating AtomiX peer and reuses the byte-identical MDS engine, with full Swap + Market + maker parity and later a native 'My market / ladder' cockpit.

nodes.label: HTLC Preimage Verification Fix (0.11.2)
nodes.rationale: Critical fix: AtomiX now verifies that a harvested HTLC preimage actually hashes to the lock before pinning it, closing a path where a bogus preimage could be trusted.

nodes.label: Shared-node Fund Hazard Fixes (0.8.x)
nodes.rationale: On a shared node: order/mail sends are pinned to a signable coin so anyone-can-spend beacon dust cannot NPE the signer (0.8.8, 0.8.10); PandaPools owner-key self-heal runs before Withdraw/Migrate/Collect (0.8.3); and a node RPC POST bug where large commands silently no-op'd (missing Content-Length) was fixed (0.8.11).

nodes.label: miniMall On-chain Shop Module
nodes.rationale: On-chain shop + vendor inbox + studio, built as the 3rd interop peer of the native miniMall apps (0.9.0-0.9.2).

nodes.label: Local SQLite Transaction History
nodes.rationale: Deep, locally-owned transaction history stored in SQLite with search/filter and per-token deltas; pool-swap history was fixed to capture both legs (MINIMA + real mxUSDT tokenamount) and read Bought/Sold correctly.

nodes.label: TERMINAL Design-System Reskin (0.6.x)
nodes.rationale: Full 'TERMINAL' reskin: black/white/orange, Manrope + Geist Mono, dark default with light toggle, adaptive wide nav-rail, sliding tab indicator, version pill.

nodes.label: PandaPools AMM Module
nodes.rationale: The PandaPools 'Pools' AMM tab is a 3rd parity peer that reuses the MDS engine byte-identical (0.4.0), brought to full frozen-quote swap + USDT-anchored create parity with the dapp.

nodes.label: Individual|Combined Pool View Toggle (0.16.2)
nodes.rationale: Folds every pool of a token into one collective-pool card (summed reserves + aggregate price + count + tradeable depth) via a Decimal-exact read-model helper. Deliberately display-only: the byte-identical PandaPools engine files are untouched to preserve 3-way parity with native 0.9.17 + MDS 0.6.8.

nodes.label: minimaMail On-chain Encrypted Messenger
nodes.rationale: Full on-chain encrypted messenger at 100% feature parity with the native Mail APK — in-chat sends, rename/archive, QR scan, passphrase backup/restore.

nodes.label: Rule 0: Follow Explicit Instructions / Reuse Before Reinvent
nodes.rationale: Authoritative working rule for this repo: user instructions are blocking; reuse existing named code before reinventing; never silently substitute your own approach; disagree openly rather than disobey quietly. Rationale: ignoring instructions wastes the user's time, tokens, and money.
nodes.norm_label: rule 0: follow explicit instructions / reuse before reinvent

nodes.label: Renderer App Shell (header + tab navigation + views)
nodes.rationale: Single-page shell: header (logo, version pill, node status chip, theme button), scrollable tab bar with data-view buttons, and one <section class=view> per tab (balances, receive, send, webwallet, mail, pandapools, atomix, ethwallet, minimall, casino, vestr, history, terminal, logs, settings, node). Most views are empty containers populated by app.js.
nodes.norm_label: renderer app shell (header + tab navigation + views)

nodes.label: Renderer Content-Security-Policy
nodes.rationale: default-src 'none' with only self scripts/styles/fonts and self+data images: the wallet renderer is locked to local assets so no remote code or exfiltration channel can load into the page holding wallet UI.

nodes.label: Hidden Casino Tab (P2PChance)
nodes.rationale: The Casino/P2PChance tab is hidden by default and unhidden by boot() only when CFG.casinoEnabled is set (a Settings 18+ self-certification) — the tab was removed from default UI in 0.11.1 but the code was preserved behind the gate.
